findings.finding: Flatness git diff utils/data.py contains only optional ImageNet-R dataset_exclude_manifest. It is scoped to iImageNetR and disabled absent path; does not modify sample lists, labels, preprocessing for this table.

findings.scope: Flowers and Flowers component of Het5
findings.finding: Flatness uses sorted directory index, Copy/formal uses canonical image_ID filename and missing-file check. Current 8189 files and 8189 frozen split entries give zero mapping mismatches. Does not establish historical image bytes or imply prior labels were wrong.
Copy/formal add class_to_idx equality guards and Het5 component label/count validation. Existing valid memberships unchanged; failures now explicit. Same Het5 order/offsets and transforms retained.
Flatness DataManager injects data_root=/data/140-0/datasets if absent; Copy/formal remove this default. Explicit run data_root/environment and realpaths must be checked before claiming same inputs.

findings.scope: Shared training LoRA backbone, all seven except CL-LoRA
findings.finding: Flatness, Copy HEAD and Sep18 formal train forward create four temporary random Linear modules unconditionally, even task_id=0. Copy working and Sep16 RNG-controlled code replace historical-factor application with F.linear and remove that CPU RNG consumption. Fixed weights and factors retain same intended forward algebra, but subsequent RNG trajectory is not guaranteed equal.

The independent _LoRA_qkv_timm_eval class is unchanged across all five versions and still creates temporary Linear modules. Do not describe working-tree train-forward change as fixing all evaluation RNG consumption.

Copy HEAD/formal vs Flatness add external_delta_w_q/v=None and conditional additions. Unset for ordinary methods; optional diagnostic/structured perturbation paths activate only when assigning tensors.

findings.scope: Vanilla SeqLoRA and inheriting EWC/GAM, not independent Inf/OLoRA/SDLoRA/CL learners
findings.finding: Copy HEAD/formal/working SeqLoRA add current-task local accuracy passes every five epochs and at task end versus Flatness. These are not behind optional flag. They traverse loaders and forward modules; with global RNG/default generator and temporary-Linears code they may shift subsequent sampling/augmentation RNG. For persistent workers iterator reuse differs, so do not claim identical base-seed redraw on every reused iteration.

Copy adds heldout Fisher split and class-order override support, but with absent/false split parameters and class_order_override absent, training set still uses all current-task examples. ewc_fisher_source default string heldout does not create heldout data: getter falls back to train_loader.

Flatness Vanilla/Inf/OLoRA/SDLoRA default min_lr=.1*LR. Copy/formal Seq support new ratio/absolute overrides but same default .1*LR. CL directly calls CosineAnnealingLR without eta_min, so min LR is zero. Merely adding min_lr to CL config is ignored by current CL implementation.

findings.scope: Aircraft especially; all datasets loader route
findings.finding: Seq/EWC/GAM use DataManager.build_dataloader with workers=train_num_workers(default8). Aircraft loader_options set pin_memory=true,persistent_workers=true and DataManager does not read top-level persistent_workers; explicit false JSON alone is ineffective here. Inf/OLoRA/SDLoRA construct DataLoader directly with default pin=false,persistent=false. CL constructs directly workers2,pin=true,persistent=false. Het5 uses own empty loader_options.

ewc_preserve_fisher_rng read and implemented in Copy/formal, default false. ewc_isolate_clean_rng not read anywhere in Copy working/HEAD/formal GAM learner; Het5 true config therefore ineffective. deterministic_loader_rng/loader_seed not implemented in Copy/formal DataManager. Sep16 rngctl has real implementations for clean isolation and per-loader generators, so differs in actual protocol.

utils/random_reproduce.py and toolkit.py byte-identical across Flatness, Copy, formal, rngctl. set_random seeds Python, NumPy, Torch CPU/CUDA and configures deterministic cuDNN; trainer calls it before DataManager/model creation in both repos. Extra reseeding sites are under disabled linear-probe workflows. Different RNG consumption, not a different initial seed function, is the concern.

Copy main adds local tmpdir and multiprocessing-cleanup handling. Trainer adds opt-in pretrained checkpoint loading, resumed-only evaluation, task0 diagnostics, epoch dynamics, staged checkpoints. Default off / no path in table configs. The normal incremental_train→eval_task→write_metrics→after_task ordering is retained. File diff alone is not evidence of different training updates.

Aside from shared backbone train-forward RNG change, targeted active files differ only in factory/inc_net KFAC/complementarity registrations and baseLoRA extra Fisher checkpoint save/restore hooks. These new branches do not change selected method mapping, and hooks are not called when staged save/resume absent.

Copy GAM optimizer saves g3 clone and introduces use_sgv gate(defaultfalse); core projected direction unchanged with gate off. AS1 learner adds selectable Fisher modes, accumulated normalization and MC Fisher; default batch_empirical plus normalize_accumulated=false preserves intended batch-mean-gradient-square Fisher trace-normalization formula. Zero-lambda fast path irrelevant to GAM lambda2000 table row. Avoid claiming bitwise historical parity: code and RNG traversal differ.

Copy working, Copy HEAD and Sep18 formal factory retain import models_LoRAbasedCL.inflora but module file is missing. Flatness has full InfLoRA implementation. Need explicit source resolution/port and frozen import proof for future Copy campaign; this does not invalidate prior Flatness result.

Current EWC table sources use model_name=as1_normfisher_fishershape. CUB/Aircraft/Cars/Flowers are alpha0 two-probe wrapper; Het5 fs_direction_mode=native_sgd uses one CE gradient. They are not factory("ewclora")→ewclora_origin and cannot blindly switch to that label. fs_preserve_probe_rng is a real implemented flag distinct from ignored GAM clean-isolation flag.
